meta.title: Random Jingle – Your Soundboard for Streams, Podcasts & Events
meta.description: Random Jingle is your free soundboard app: upload your own jingles, trim them, and play them live at the tap of a button – online or offline.

hero.claim: Your soundboard for the perfect moment.
hero.subClaim: Upload sounds, trim them precisely, and play them live – on stream, in your podcast, or on stage. Free, works offline, ready in seconds.

benefits.heading: Core benefits
benefits.item1Text: Tap a jingle, done. No digging through folders – one click and the sound plays.
benefits.item2Text: Installable as an app on phone, tablet, and desktop. With cloud sync your board is there on every device instantly.
benefits.item3Text: Upload your own audio files, trim them precisely, and organize them into color-coded categories.

features.heading: Feature overview
features.item1Text: Sort your jingles into categories and let the random button create moments of surprise.
features.item2Text: Cut the start and end of any sound precisely, right in the waveform view.
features.item3Text: Sign in and sync your entire board across devices – always identical, everywhere.
features.item4Text: Once installed, Random Jingle also works with no internet connection at all – perfect for spotty venues.
features.item5Text: Assign a shortcut to every jingle and trigger sounds instantly, no mouse needed.

audiences.heading: Who is this for?
audiences.item1Text: React to chat moments in real time with sound effects – from laughs to drum rolls, one click or hotkey away.
audiences.item2Text: Drop stings and transitions exactly where you need them, without pausing the recording or switching software.
audiences.item3Text: Keep announcements, effects, and hype sounds ready for the next moment on the floor – trimmed and instant.
audiences.item4Text: Play jingles, station idents, and inserts live on air – no heavyweight broadcast software required.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.step1Text: Upload your audio files (MP3/WAV) right in the browser.
howItWorks.step2Text: Sort them into categories and trim them precisely using the waveform view.
howItWorks.step3Text: Install Random Jingle as an app on your device – free, no app store needed.
howItWorks.step4Text: Start your stream, podcast, or set and play your jingles with a click or hotkey.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Random Jingle is completely free to use. No hidden costs, no pro version.
faq.a2: No. The app works fully offline and locally without signing in. A free account is only useful if you want to sync your board across devices.
faq.a3: Yes. Once installed, Random Jingle works entirely without an internet connection.
faq.a4: MP3 and WAV files are currently supported.
